- ECON 317 Introduction to Statistics for Economists Units: 4 *

### Note:

---

*The sequence MATH 307 /MATH 308 or the sequence MATH 407 /MATH 408 may be substituted for ECON 317 .

notes.text: This 60-unit major blends core economics instruction with course work in data science, computer science and mathematics to train students to apply advanced data science techniques to the analysis and formulation of economic problems.
